tasks.title: FR-001 Beacon 必须定义项目拓扑与分支治理的 project-version metadata schema
tasks.description: 该 schema 至少必须支持： `global_project_metadata` `version_scoped_metadata` `topology_kind`: `single_repo | monorepo` `project_root` `service_repo_roots[]` `default_execution_service` `service_bindings[]` `version_contracts[]` `metadata_status` 每条 `service_binding` 至少必须表达： service key repo root role writable vs reference-only intent worktree path policy 每条 `version_contract` 至少必须表达： Beacon version participating service set per-service allowed working branch branch guard mode violation behavior 同时，Beacon 必须把元信息明确拆成两层： 1. 全局项目级元信息 跨版本共享 描述项目公共事实 至少包括： `project_root` `topology_kind` `service_repo_roots` `service bindings` `default_execution_service` 2. 版本级元信息 与某个明确的 `vX.Y.Z` 绑定 描述该版本线的交付契约 至少包括： `version -> service set` `version -> per-service allowed working branch` `version-specific writable scope` `version-specific branch guard mode` `version-specific validation state` 该模型的边界必须保持极简： Beacon 核心 metadata 只表达“当前允许执行的 working branch truth”。 Beacon 核心 metadata 不表达完整项目 Git workflow，例如 integration branch、testing branch、uat branch、merge flow graph。 若项目需要 `service dev branch -> shared integration branch -> testing/uat` 之类协作规则，必须通过项目内 skill / policy 管理，而不是扩张 Beacon 核心 schema。

tasks.title: FR-009 domain classifier 必须新增元信息治理规则
tasks.description: Beacon 必须把以下问题优先识别为元信息治理域，而不是宽泛 `prompt`： `monorepo` `branch-governance` `repo-binding` 分类器至少必须支持： 依据原始 note、evidence、resolved metadata mismatch 命中上述 domain 将该类项路由到 project-version metadata governance 语义，而不是普通 prompt 优化语义 在 `friction-intake -> brainstorm/change/prd` 链路中保留该 domain，不得被后续流程静默改写回 `prompt` ## 6. 边界 / 分层 / 恢复 ### 6.1 边界 requirement truth 不会单独下沉为 sqlite 真相 sqlite projection 不能反向成为 docs 或 machine truth 的写入源 metadata governance 只覆盖 topology 与 version-branch execution contract，不扩张为完整交付编排 ### 6.2 分层 canonical metadata envelope 是唯一写入源 human sink 是面向评审与操作者理解的层 machine sink 是面向确定性 runtime 与校验的层 sqlite sink 是面向快速查询与治理投影的层 ### 6.3 恢复 failed metadata transaction 必须保持可检查 sqlite projection 必须能从 canonical metadata truth 重建 drifted sink 必须通过 replay canonical transaction 修复，而不是分别手工补丁 ## 7. Data and projection model ### 7.1 Canonical metadata envelope Beacon 必须定义面向 project-version governance 的 canonical metadata envelope，至少包含： schema version project key project root topology kind service bindings version contracts branch guard rules transaction metadata ### 7.2 Human-readable sink Beacon 必须投影一份可供人类评审的 metadata 文档，至少解释： project topology classification service repo mapping version to service set mapping per-service allowed working branches current validation status 绝对 `project_root` 各关键 artifact 的绝对路径 ### 7.3 Machine-readable sink Beacon 必须投影 machine-consumable metadata，供 prompt/runtime/status/doctor/gate 消费；该 sink 必须稳定且适合后续自动化消费。 对于 `latest.json` 这类 machine pointer 文件，必须同时保存： `project_root` 相对 artifact path 对应绝对 artifact path 生成该 pointer 的 transaction / run metadata ### 7.4 SQLite runtime projection sink Beacon 必须扩展或复用 runtime ledger 表来物化快速查询和校验所需的 metadata。现有 `git_scopes` 与 `git_workspace_bindings` 可以复用，但只有被纳入新的 canonical metadata contract 后才算满足要求。 ### 7.5 Versioned mutation history Metadata mutation 必须留下足够的 append-only transaction history，用于： audit rollback guidance drift diagnosis sqlite projection rebuild 后的 replay ## 8. 验收标准 ### AC-001 元信息双层模型冻结 Beacon 明确定义全局项目级元信息与版本级元信息两层模型。 `topology_kind`、`service bindings`、`version contracts`、`per-service allowed working branch`、`branch guard mode` 都有固定字段边界。 ### AC-002 提示层按版本读取 resolved metadata view 当用户使用 `beacon:子skill + vX.Y.Z` 或显式 `--version vX.Y.Z` 时，提示层通过运行层读取： 全局项目级元信息 该版本对应的版本级元信息 提示层不再自行重推断 monorepo / service / branch 事实。 ### AC-003 人类面 metadata support surface 闭环成立 `beacon doctor metadata show/create/update/delete/list/verify` 命令面固定。 增删改查与校验都走 canonical transaction。 ### AC-003A Change loop requirement package dual-write is closed `beacon-change / reopen / freeze` 成功结束时，human requirement docs、`.machine` requirement materials、revision/story state 已在同一 canonical transaction 下对齐。 正常变更路径不再要求操作者追加执行 `doctor sync-materials` 来补齐 `.machine`。 `doctor sync-materials` 只作为 repair / rebuild 手段保留。 ### AC-004 Cross-project 输出无歧义 human/json 输出显式显示绝对 `project_root`。 “落盘位置”至少在 cross-project 模式下打印绝对路径。 `latest.json` 同时给出相对与绝对 artifact path。 ### AC-005 元信息类 friction 不再误分到 `prompt` `monorepo / branch-governance / repo-binding` 命中新增 domain classifier 规则。 该类问题进入 project-version metadata governance 语义线，而不是普通 prompt 优化线。 ### AC-006 分支与仓绑定违例时硬阻断 `implement / qa / release` 在 repo/service/branch/worktree 与 metadata contract 不一致时停止执行。 错误输出包含确定性修复指引与关联 metadata artifact 定位。 ## 6. Diagram Truth Layer ### 6.1 Branch-flow ```text real-project friction -> classify as metadata-governance -> resolve project-level metadata -> resolve version-scoped metadata -> build resolved metadata view -> choose execution surface -> metadata contract pass -> implement / qa / release continue -> requirement package drift -> beacon-change -> machine requirement artifact missing -> doctor sync-materials -> version-line package closure missing -> doctor verify-materials --strict -> repo / branch / worktree mismatch -> hard block with repair guidance ``` 若真实项目摩擦被识别为 `monorepo / branch-governance / repo-binding`，必须进入 metadata governance 主线，而不是回退到 `prompt`。 若 metadata contract 已存在，prompt/runtime/support surface 必须先消费 resolved metadata view，再决定是否继续执行。 若 requirement package 漂移属于变更闭环问题，优先回到 `beacon-change`。 若问题是 machine requirement artifact 缺件，优先进入 `doctor sync-materials` repair 路径。 若问题是 version-line package closure 缺口，优先进入 `doctor verify-materials --strict` 诊断路径。 ### 6.2 State-machine ```text metadata_absent -> metadata_curated -> metadata_verified -> resolved_view_active -> execution_guarded -> remediation_proven ``` 异常回路： ```text execution_guarded -> requirement_package_drift_detected -> change_loop_repair | machine_repair | version_line_verify -> execution_guarded ``` ```text metadata_verified -> branch_or_repo_mismatch -> blocked_with_guidance -> metadata_update_or_branch_fix -> metadata_verified ``` `metadata_absent`：项目与版本元信息尚未建立 `metadata_curated`：human/machine/sqlite 材料已落盘 `metadata_verified`：`doctor metadata verify` 与 `doctor verify-materials --strict` 均满足当前版本线契约 `resolved_view_active`：prompt/runtime/support surface 统一消费 resolved metadata view `execution_guarded`：implement/qa/release 已受 metadata 与 requirement package 强门禁保护 `remediation_proven`：`help / status / real-project-validation` 已能证明 remediation 分流动作 ### 6.3 Decision-priority 本子线的决策优先级必须保持： 1. 版本与项目元信息的确定性校验，高于 prompt 期重新推断 2. `beacon-change` 主路径双写闭环，高于后置人工 repair 3. requirement package fail-closed，高于“带漂移继续执行” 4. 核心 metadata 极简边界，高于把项目级 Git workflow 编进 Beacon 核心 5. real-project proof 可回放性，高于只在局部单测里成立 ### 6.4 State Axes 本子线至少显式建模以下 state axes： `topology_axis` `single_repo` `monorepo` `metadata_scope_axis` `global_project_metadata` `version_scoped_metadata` `resolved_metadata_view` `requirement_package_axis` `human_docs_synced` `machine_package_synced` `revision_baseline_bound` `drift_blocked` `remediation_axis` `beacon_change` `doctor_sync_materials` `doctor_verify_materials` `execution_surface_axis` `implement` `qa` `release` `help` `status` `real_project_validation` ## 7. 风险与缓解 | Risk | Impact | Mitigation | |------|------|------| | Metadata becomes a second informal hint layer instead of hard contract | High | Force runtime consumers to read canonical metadata first and hard-block on violations | | Human sink and sqlite sink drift | High | Shared transaction metadata, checksum verification, and doctor/gate drift reporting | | Operators bypass metadata commands and patch one sink directly | High | Expose explicit support commands and make verification surfaces detect out-of-band drift | | Model is too loose for monorepo realities | High | Require topology kind, service bindings, version contracts, and working-branch guard fields as structured data | | LLM continues to re-infer service/branch facts even when metadata exists | High | Prompt/runtime contract must treat metadata as fixed truth inputs | ## 8. 验收标准 ### AC-001 Structured metadata truth exists Beacon 能持久化 project-version metadata，并以确定性方式表达 monorepo / single-repo 拓扑、service repo bindings、以及 version-branch contracts。 ### AC-002 Canonical transaction governs all metadata writes A metadata mutation results in one canonical transaction whose human sink, machine sink, and sqlite sink share the same transaction lineage and consistency metadata. ### AC-003 Human metadata governance surface exists for explicit governance 操作者能通过 `beacon doctor metadata ...` 显式新增、查询、修改、删除、校验 topology / service / working-branch metadata，而不是手改各类 sink。项目如需更复杂的人类协作引导，可通过项目内 skill 承载。 ### AC-003A Requirement package dual-write is closed inside the change loop `beacon-change / reopen / freeze` 的正常路径会直接对齐 human requirement docs、`.machine` requirement materials、revision/story state，不再要求人工补跑 `doctor sync-materials`。 ### AC-004 Runtime contract consumption is deterministic When metadata exists, Beacon prompt/runtime flows use it as the primary truth source and no longer require repeated service/branch inference for normal operation. ### AC-005 Execution gates block on metadata mismatch `implement`, `qa`, and `release` stop deterministically when runtime repo/branch/worktree state violates the active metadata contract. ### AC-006 Multi-sink drift is auditable `status`、`doctor`、`gate` 或等价治理 surface 能检测 failed metadata transaction 与 sink drift。 ### AC-007 Cross-project reporting is unambiguous Human-visible metadata outputs identify the absolute project root and artifact locations clearly enough to avoid cross-workspace confusion. ## 9. Success metrics 降低真实项目执行中的重复 LLM / service / branch 推断 降低错误分支或错误 service 启动 implement 的概率 提升 branch / topology mismatch 的确定性阻断速度 降低 Beacon 核心仓与目标项目仓并行操作时的人类歧义 ## 10. Dependencies and open questions Decide whether metadata human sink lives under `docs/beacon/<version>/execution/` or another version-scoped governance path Decide whether current git ledger tables are extended or wrapped by a new canonical projection layer Keep metadata support commands on `beacon doctor metadata ...`; do not add a new primary public command Define rollback semantics for metadata transactions that partially validate but fail to publish
